name: @ryntra/arc-verify
description: Check a Ryntra receipt yourself: the receipt schema, its canonical serialization and both seals, the EIP-712 signature and the hour's anchor of what Ryntra's executor did, and the transfer, payout, USDC/EURC exchange or action it records read back from Arc over public JSON-RPC. Read-only; no keys, no signing.
author: Dmytro Plavutskyi
